correctness.rationale: For k>=8, n=3k-2 and d in {0,1,2,3}, the powered distance matrix is t(J-I)-(t-1)A_k+(u-t)A_{k-1}, t=2^p,u=3^p. Johnson scheme mode j has Lambda_j=-t+b_j[(u-t)r_j-(t-1)], b_j=(-1)^j C(2k-2-j,k-j), r_j=(k^2-3kj+j(j+1))/(k-1). Monotone Lambda_2/2^p has a unique positive zero, while all other eigenvalues are negative there via parity-dependent binomial-ratio bounds. Schoenberg then gives exact p-negative type and affine embedding rank. Exact k7 rational-power enclosures show a third-mode obstruction before second-mode crossing. Infinite k is proved by mode inequalities, not floating-point sampling.
residual_risks: Finite checks establish only their stated finite domains; infinite conclusions depend on analytic argument.
